mapper.select: SELECT ic.code, ic.name, ic.unit, curr.value AS value, prev.value AS prev_value, curr.observation_date AS observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation curr ON ic.id = curr.indicator_id AND curr.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o1.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o1 WHERE o1.indicator_id = ic.id ) LEFT JOIN indicator_observation prev ON ic.id = prev.indicator_id AND prev.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o2 WHERE o2.indicator_id = ic.id AND o2.observation_date < curr.observation_date ) WHERE ic.code IN ('FED_NET_LIQ', 'M2_YOY', 'MMMFFAQ027S', 'WRESBAL') ORDER BY ic.id

SELECT io.observation_date, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'FED_NET_LIQ' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS net_liquidity, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'WALCL' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS fed_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'WTREGEN' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS tga, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'RRPONTSYD' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS rrp, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'M2SL' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS m2, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'M2_YOY' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS m2_yoy, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'MMMFFAQ027S' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS mmf, SUM(CASE WHEN ic.code = 'WRESBAL' THEN io.value ELSE 0 END) AS reserves FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('FED_NET_LIQ', 'WALCL', 'WTREGEN', 'RRPONTSYD', 'M2SL', 'M2_YOY', 'MMMFFAQ027S', 'WRESBAL') GROUP BY io.observation_date ORDER BY io.observation_date

SELECT ic.code, ic.name, ic.unit, curr.value AS current_value, prev.value AS previous_value, curr.observation_date AS current_date, prev.observation_date AS previous_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation curr ON ic.id = curr.indicator_id AND curr.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o1.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o1 WHERE o1.indicator_id = ic.id ) LEFT JOIN indicator_observation prev ON ic.id = prev.indicator_id AND prev.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o2 WHERE o2.indicator_id = ic.id AND o2.observation_date < curr.observation_date ) WHERE ic.code IN ('FED_NET_LIQ', 'M2_YOY', 'MMMFFAQ027S', 'WRESBAL') ORDER BY ic.id
mapper.insert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO indicator_observation (indicator_id, observation_date, published_at, value, source_url, collected_at) VALUES ( (SELECT id FROM indicator_catalog WHERE code = #{code}), #{observation_date}, #{published_at}, #{value}, #{source_url}, datetime('now') )
